brand.name: SyndicUp
brand.tagline: Your co-ownership, managed with peace of mind.
brand.subtitle: Service charges, general meetings, incidents and documents — for property managers and residents in Morocco.

common.irreversible: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
common.errorBody: The problem is on our side, not yours. Please try again in a moment.
common.forbidden: You do not have access to this page.
common.notFoundBody: This page does not exist or has been moved.

nav.quickTitle: What would you like to do?

typeMajoriteAide.SIMPLE: More than half of the shares cast.
typeMajoriteAide.DOUBLE: Majority by number of voters AND by shares.

legalGate.banner: Legal setting not configured — awaiting legal confirmation.
legalGate.bannerBody: This value must be confirmed by a legal adviser before it can be used. The platform never guesses a legal value.
legalGate.notABug: This is a deliberate choice by the platform, not a malfunction.

auth.loginSubtitle: Your email and password are all you need.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email address: we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a link has just been sent. It is valid for one hour. Please check your spam folder.
auth.resetSubtitle: Choose a password of at least 8 characters.
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.resetInvalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {s} seconds.
auth.rateLimitedGeneric: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment before trying again.
auth.invalidPhone: This number does not seem valid.
auth.securityNote: Secure login. Your data is protected under law 09-08 (CNDP).
auth.inviteAs: You are invited to join {copro} as {role}.
auth.inviteSignInFirst: Log in or create your access to accept the invitation.
auth.inviteAccepted: Invitation accepted. Your account is being validated.
auth.inviteCodeHint: The 8-character code provided by your property manager.
auth.inviteExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask your property manager to regenerate it.
auth.inviteOuverteAilleurs: This invitation has already been opened on another device: each code can only be used once. Ask your property manager to generate a new one for you.
auth.inviteAlreadyUsed: This invitation has already been used. If it was you, simply log in.
auth.inviteInvalid: This invitation code is not valid.
auth.inviteEmailAide: You will use this email to log in.
auth.inviteInvalide: This invitation code does not exist. Please check it with the person who invited you.
auth.inviteBienvenue: Welcome! Your access to {nom} is active.
auth.scanHint: Point the camera at your invitation QR code — it is read automatically.
auth.scanDenied: Camera unavailable or denied: enter the code manually.
auth.scanInvalid: This QR code is not a SyndicUp invitation.
auth.scanInsecure: The camera is only available over HTTPS. Open the app via its secure address, or scan the QR code with your phone's camera: it opens the invitation directly.
auth.inviteVosInfosAide: They will be visible to your property manager and on your documents. This invitation code is single-use: once accepted, no one else can use it.
auth.chooseCoproSubtitle: Your account is linked to several residences. You can switch at any time.
auth.suspendedBody: Your access to this residence is suspended. Contact your property manager to find out more.
auth.validationBody: Your registration is almost complete. The property manager still needs to validate your link to the residence — you will be notified as soon as it is done.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.

dash.recouvrementHint: Share of issued service charges actually collected.
dash.monSoldeAJour: Your service charges are up to date.

lots.title: Units
lots.subtitle: {count} units · {tantiemes} shares allocated
lots.batimentAide: Block or building in a multi-building residence (e.g. A, B) — target of “One building” notices.
lots.lotParentAide: Link a parking space or cellar to a main unit.
lots.aucunLotAide: Start by creating the residence's units: apartments, parking spaces, cellars…
lots.representantAide: In joint ownership, only the representative votes at the general meeting.
lots.quotePartRegle: Active shares must add up to exactly 100 %.
lots.accesFinancesAide: Allows a tenant to view the unit's balance.
lots.utilisateurIdAide: User ID (shown on their member profile).
lots.transfertSoldeNul: This unit's service charges are up to date. The transfer can go ahead smoothly.
lots.transfertDette: This unit has a debt of {montant}.
lots.transfertDetteReprise: The buyer takes over the unit's debt
lots.transfertDetteRepriseAide: By ticking this box, you certify that the agreement between seller and buyer provides for the debt to be taken over. Without this certification, the transfer is refused.
lots.transfertCoordonneesAide: An invitation will be generated for them — you will pass on the code.
lots.transfertConfirme: I confirm the transfer of ownership
lots.transfertConfirmeAide: The former owner will lose access to the unit. An invitation will be created for the new owner.
lots.transfertCodeInvitation: Invitation code to pass on to the new owner:
lots.transfertRappel: Once the invitation is accepted, add the new owner to the unit from the Ownership tab.
lots.historiqueVide: No transfer recorded for this unit.

finances.budgetsSubtitle: Without an active budget, no funds call can be issued.
finances.activerBudgetCorps: If a budget is already active for the {exercice} financial year, it will automatically become “Replaced” (revised budget). Upcoming funds calls will be based on this new budget.
finances.budgetActifRequis: No active budget for this financial year.
finances.aucunBudgetAide: Create the financial year's budget, then activate it to be able to issue funds calls.
finances.montantAide: Annual amount voted at the general meeting, in dirhams.
finances.appelsSubtitle: Allocated automatically between units in proportion to shares.
finances.montantReparti: Allocated automatically between all units in proportion to their shares.
finances.lignesSubtitle: The lines add up to the total amount, to the cent.
finances.aucunAppelAide: Generate your first funds call — it will be allocated automatically between the units.
finances.appelDejaEmis: A funds call already exists for this period and type.
finances.paiementFifoAide: Choose a unit and an amount: it will be applied automatically to the oldest instalments.
finances.paiementLigneAide: The payment will be applied to this line only.
finances.payeurAide: Fill in if someone else pays for the owner (e.g. the tenant).
finances.tropPercuAide: Allows a payment greater than the amount due on this line.
finances.quittanceGeneree: The payment settles the line — the receipt has been generated automatically.
finances.avanceNonSupportee: The amount exceeds the unit's total due. Advance payments are not supported yet.
finances.quittanceCorps: The property manager acknowledges receipt of full payment of the funds call line below.
finances.quittanceConservation: Document with tax value — keep it for 10 years.
finances.soldeAJour: This unit's service charges are up to date.
finances.contesterMention: The amount remains due while the dispute is reviewed. The property manager will reply in the app.
finances.contestationEnvoyee: Dispute sent to the property manager.
finances.contestationsSubtitle: Service charge disputes submitted by residents.
finances.cmiIndisponible: Online payment is coming soon. In the meantime, pay by bank transfer, cheque or cash to your property manager.

ag.aucuneAgAide: Create a meeting, add its resolutions, then send the notice of meeting to co-owners.
ag.aucuneResolutionAide: Add the resolutions to be put to the vote.
ag.convoquerAide: Each co-owner will receive their notice of meeting. The date must respect the configured legal notice period.
ag.annulerCorps: Co-owners will be informed. This reason will be kept on file.
ag.ouvrirSeanceAide: To be done on the day of the meeting. The quorum will be recorded at opening.
ag.cloturerCorps: Closing is final: it locks the results and generates the minutes. All resolutions must be finalised.
ag.cloturee: Meeting closed. The minutes are being generated.
ag.voteConfirmCorps: You are voting “{valeur}” on resolution {ordre}. A vote is final and cannot be changed.
ag.voteImmuable: Votes cannot be changed — this is what gives them legal value.
ag.dejaVote: You have already voted on this resolution.
ag.finaliserCorps: Calculates the final result (adopted or rejected). Reminder: in the event of a perfect tie, the resolution is rejected.
ag.toutesFinalisees: All resolutions are finalised — the meeting can be closed.
ag.procurationsAide: Absent on the day of the meeting? Entrust your vote to another co-owner.
ag.mandataireAide: The co-owner who will vote on your behalf.
ag.limiteProcurations: This proxy holder has reached the authorised proxy limit.
ag.pvHashAide: This SHA-256 fingerprint makes the minutes tamper-proof: any change to the content would alter it.
ag.pvIndisponible: The minutes will be available once the meeting is closed.
ag.detailVotesBandeau: Breakdown reserved for the property manager for audit purposes — residents only see aggregated results.
ag.voteAnonymeNote: Other co-owners' votes are anonymous. Only totals are shown.
ag.indivisaireImpaye: A joint owner whose unit has unpaid charges cannot vote.

incidents.emplacementConcerneAide: Parking space or shared cellar (vehicle in my space, forced door…).
incidents.immatriculationSignaleeAide: As read on the vehicle — the caretaker will find the unit and notify its owner.
incidents.notifierVehiculeAide: The plate is looked up among declared vehicles (search is logged); the unit's residents receive a notification.
incidents.partieAide: The riser pipe is common; your taps are private.
incidents.urgenceMaxAide: Reserved for immediate dangers: the whole building will be alerted at once.
incidents.descriptionHint: Describe what you see: where, since when, what it causes…
incidents.photosAide: A picture is worth a thousand words: up to 5 images to help with the diagnosis.
incidents.lotConcerneAide: Leave blank if the problem concerns the common areas in general.
incidents.lierSejourAide: Nuisance during a short-term rental: the stay concerned will be recorded.
incidents.assignerAide: The ticket will automatically move to “In progress”.
incidents.commentaireHint: This comment will be visible in the incident log.
incidents.aucunIncidentAide: Incidents reported by residents and the caretaker will appear here.
incidents.signale: Incident reported. The property manager has been notified.
incidents.signaleUrgent: Incident reported. All residents have been alerted.
incidents.aucunPrestataireAide: Add your usual contractors: plumber, electrician, cleaning company…

gestion.supprimerIrreversible: This action is permanent. If the item already has a history, the platform will refuse the deletion and suggest deactivating it instead.
gestion.invitationAnnulerAide: The code will stop working immediately. A record of the invitation is kept.
gestion.lotSupprimerAide: Only for a unit created by mistake: with no owner, occupant or funds call. A unit with a history is kept.
gestion.documentSupprimerAide: The file will be removed for all residents. GM minutes and receipts generated by the platform cannot be deleted.

espaces.subtitle: Party room, sports ground, pool… bookable by residents.
espaces.creneauPris: This slot is already booked. Please choose another time.
espaces.reservationEnAttente: Request sent — awaiting the property manager's approval.
espaces.aucunEspaceAide: Create the residence's bookable areas: party room, sports ground…
espaces.motifRejetAide: The resident will see this reason.
espaces.annulerReservationCorps: The slot will be freed up for other residents.
espaces.aucuneReservationAide: Book a common area from the Common areas page.

visites.enregistree: Visit recorded. The resident has been notified.
visites.aucuneVisiteAide: Visitors recorded by the caretaker will appear here.
visites.demandeAcces: {nom} is requesting access to your unit {lot}.
visites.reponseUnique: Only one reply possible — it will be passed on to the caretaker.
visites.dejaRepondu: A reply has already been given for this visit.

personnel.subtitle: The residence's caretakers and employees.
personnel.logementAide: Only a unit of type “Caretaker's lodge”.
personnel.utilisateurAide: The user must already have an active Caretaker role (invite them first).
personnel.absentAlerte: Caretaker absent — remember to arrange a replacement.
personnel.aucuneFicheAide: Create your caretaker's record to track attendance and staff accommodation.
personnel.planningSubtitle: The staff week: hours, approved leave, replacements and attendance.
personnel.paieMoisSubtitle: Payslips for the period, employees without a payslip and total employer cost.
personnel.cnssAide: Each view of the full number is audited.
personnel.horairesAide: One or two time slots per day (HH:MM). Leave blank for a non-working day.
personnel.contratTravailAide: PDF or photo of the signed contract (property manager only).
personnel.departAide: The “Left” status frees up the staff accommodation (Doc A §9.2).
personnel.preparerFicheAide: The draft is calculated using the residence's payroll settings; unjustified absences recorded for the month are deducted automatically.
personnel.joursAbsenceAide: Leave blank to use the month's “Absent” records.
personnel.validerFicheCorps: The calculation is locked with the current settings and a “Staff” expense (total employer cost) is created, then submitted like any other expense. The employee is notified and can download their payslip.
personnel.payerFicheCorps: Payment goes through the linked expense (method, bank reference, date, proof); the payslip becomes “Paid”.
personnel.mentionPaie: Calculation aid generated from the settings entered by the property manager — not a certified payslip.
personnel.paieNonConfigureeCorps: Enter the CNSS / AMO rates, the IR scale, the SMIG and leave days in Settings → Payroll before validating a payslip (provisional values, brief §11).
personnel.sousSmig: Gross salary below the configured SMIG
personnel.demanderCongeAide: Working days (Monday → Saturday) are counted automatically; attach a certificate for sick leave.
personnel.saisirPresencesAide: Tick the status for each day of the month; unjustified absences are deducted from pay if the setting is enabled.
personnel.evaluerAide: One rating per reviewer and per period; visible to the property manager and council only.
personnel.interdit: You do not have access to this file.
personnel.chargementImpossible: Some data could not be loaded — please try again.

documents.subtitle: Rules, minutes, contracts and reports of the residence.
documents.typeHint: E.g. house rules, minutes, contract, report…

visibiliteAide.PUBLIC_COPROPRIETE: All members of the residence, including tenants and the caretaker.
visibiliteAide.CONSEIL_SYNDICAL: You and the owners' council members.

documents.fichierAide: PDF, image or spreadsheet — 50 MB maximum.
documents.telechargement: The download opens in a new tab. The link is valid for 15 minutes.
documents.aucunDocumentAide: Add the house rules, minutes and contracts of the residence.
documents.storagePathAide: Path of the file in storage (uploaded beforehand).

notifs.lectureEchec: The read status could not be saved: the notification remains unread.
notifs.aucuneAide: Here you will find events that concern you: funds calls, meetings, visits…

litiges.typeHint: E.g. service charge dispute, nuisances, unauthorised works…
litiges.descriptionHint: Describe the situation as precisely as possible.
litiges.escaladerCorps: The dispute will move to the “{niveau}” level. This step is final — a dispute is never moved back down.
litiges.cloturerAide: “Resolved”: a solution was found. “Closed”: the file is closed without agreement.
litiges.declare: Dispute reported. The property manager will review it.
litiges.aucunAide: Disputes reported by residents will appear here.

profil.langueAide: Changes the whole interface, including reading direction.
profil.langueDocuments: Official documents, e-mails and notifications remain in French or Arabic.
profil.identifiantsAide: Your email and phone are used to log in — they cannot be changed here.
profil.donneesCorps: In accordance with law 09-08 on the protection of personal data, you can download all the data the platform holds about you.
profil.donneesConservation: Financial data (payments, receipts) and meeting votes are kept for 10 years after your link to the residence ends — this is a legal and accounting obligation.
profil.exportFormat: Export in JSON format, readable by any spreadsheet or analysis tool.

alive.sensationsAide: App motion, vibrations and sounds. These settings stay on this device.
alive.animationsAide: “Reduced” replaces motion with simple fades. Your device's accessibility setting is always respected.
alive.vibrationsAide: Subtle feedback when an action is confirmed or refused.
alive.vibrationsWeb: Available on Android phones; no effect on computers and iPhone.
alive.sonsAide: A few gentle sounds at key moments: payment recorded, sending, annexes generated. Your phone's silent mode is respected.
alive.lite: Power saving mode on: ambient effects are paused to save battery.
alive.testAide: Development screen: plays every sound and vibration, ignoring your settings.
alive.horsLigne: You are offline — the data shown may be out of date.

membres.annuaireSubtitle: Everyone linked to the residence: roles, units, contact details and account status.
membres.aucunAide: Invite your residents, caretaker and contractors: they will appear here as soon as they sign up.
membres.anonymiserCorps: This person's name, email and phone will be permanently erased. Financial history and votes are kept (legal obligation, 10 years). This action requires the account to be deactivated first.
membres.anonymiserConfirme: I understand that this action is permanent
membres.anonymiserRefus: The account must be deactivated before it can be anonymised.

invitations.usageUniqueAide: Each code can only be used once: as soon as it is scanned or entered, it is linked to that device and no one else can use it. If there is a problem, regenerate it.
invitations.subtitle: Invite residents, caretakers and contractors to join the residence.
invitations.roleAide: An owner or tenant must be linked to a unit; a caretaker does not.
invitations.transmettre: Pass this code on to the invited person:
invitations.ouQr: or have them scan this QR code:
invitations.aucuneAide: Create an invitation to give access to a resident, caretaker or contractor.
invitations.envoiManuel: SyndicUp does not send invitations automatically yet: copy the code or link and pass it on yourself.

parametres.logoAide: It replaces the generic icon throughout the app (menu, mobile bar) for you and all residents. PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, preferably square.
parametres.photosAide: They decorate the home page, units, documents, meetings and common areas for you and all residents. Without a photo, the default image is shown. JPG, PNG or WebP, preferably landscape.
parametres.photosEspacesAide: Each area can have its own photo on its booking card.
parametres.totalTantiemesAide: The sum of shares of all units cannot exceed this total.
parametres.recouvrementAide: Time limits (in days after the due date) for each automatic reminder level.
parametres.paieAide: Rates and scales used to calculate payslips. PROVISIONAL values to be confirmed (brief §11) — state their source. Blank = not configured: no payslip can be validated.
parametres.paieTranchesAide: One line per bracket: upper limit (blank for the last one); rate (%); amount to deduct.
parametres.legauxBanner: These values must be confirmed by a legal adviser before being entered. As long as they are blank, the related features remain locked — this is deliberate.
parametres.delaiExecutionAide: After the GM, due date of the “Carry out the resolution” task (brief §13). Blank = task with no due date.
parametres.delaiConvocationAide: Minimum number of days between the notice of meeting and the meeting itself.
parametres.quorumPremiereAide: Fraction of shares required to open the session (e.g. 0.5 for half).
parametres.limiteProcurationsAide: Maximum number of co-owners one person can represent.
parametres.retentionAide: How long a deactivated account is kept before automatic anonymisation (CNDP).

admin.subtitle: All residences on the platform.
admin.creeeInviter: Residence created. Now invite its first property manager.
admin.syndicAide: Generate the first property manager's invitation code and pass it on: they create their own credentials — you never handle any password.
admin.messageWhatsApp: Hello! Here is your property manager access to {nom} on SyndicUp: {lien} — invitation code: {code}

onboarding.welcomeBody: I'm Dari, your assistant. Follow me: in one minute, I'll show you where everything is — right in the app, screen by screen.
onboarding.navDashBody: Everything starts here. Click this menu item at any time to return to your overview.
onboarding.statsBody: Collections, unpaid charges, incidents, units: these cards update in real time. Tap one to open the details.
onboarding.navFinancesBody: Funds calls, budgets and disputes live in this section of the menu. Let's look at the funds calls.
onboarding.appelsPageBody: Each call shows who has paid and what is still due. Open a line for the breakdown by unit — and create a new call from the button at the top of the page.
onboarding.navAgBody: Notices of meeting, agendas, votes in session and minutes: the residence's entire democratic life is behind this item.
onboarding.navIncidentsBody: A leak, a breakdown? This is where everything is reported and tracked. Let's go.
onboarding.incidentsPageBody: Each incident has an urgency, a status and a response deadline. The button at the top of the page lets you report a new one.
onboarding.navDocsBody: The residence's rules, minutes, contracts and receipts, all in one place. Last step of the tour.
onboarding.docViewBody: The “View” button opens the document directly in the app — on computer and phone alike.
onboarding.searchBody: Type the name of a page to go there instantly, without using the menu.
onboarding.bellBody: Payments, notices of meeting, replies to your reports: everything that concerns you arrives here.
onboarding.doneBody: You now know the essentials. And if a question comes up, I'm right here at the bottom of the screen. Welcome to your residence!
onboarding.clickHint: Click the highlighted item to continue
onboarding.adminNavBody: All the platform's residences live here. Your role: create them and invite their property manager — each property manager then runs their own space.
onboarding.adminNewBody: Two steps, all in the interface: the residence, then the property manager's invitation code to pass on. No passwords to manage.
onboarding.dariBody: Your assistant. I know your residence and every screen of the app: ask me anything at any time, I'll answer and take you to the right place.

dari.intro: I know your residence and the app. Here's what matters today:
dari.introMoi: {role} · {residence} ({lots}). I know your file and every screen of the app — here's what matters today:
dari.etatErreur: I can't read your file right now.
dari.rienAFaire: Nothing urgent for now — everything is in order.
dari.indisponible: Chat is not yet enabled for this space. The pointers above stay up to date.
dari.sature: I'm very busy right now — please try again in a few seconds.
dari.trop: You've asked me a lot of questions: let's take a short break for a few minutes.
dari.erreur: I couldn't reply. Check your connection and try again.
dari.avertissement: Dari can make mistakes: check amounts on the relevant screen.
dari.bulleTexte: I'm Dari, your assistant. I guide you everywhere in the app.
dari.chargement: Dari is looking at your residence…

comptabilite.parMoisAideResident: What you were called for and what you paid, period by period.
comptabilite.journalAideResident: Your payments recorded by the property manager, most recent first.
comptabilite.aucunPaiementResident: No payment recorded for this financial year. Payments are entered by the property manager on receipt.
comptabilite.parcoursSous: Everything else (balances, arrears, statements, CSV) is calculated automatically from these three actions.
comptabilite.etapeBudgetAide: The financial year's budget sets what each unit owes, in proportion to shares.
comptabilite.etapeAppelAide: The call automatically allocates the budget between units and creates the lines to collect.
comptabilite.etapePaiementAide: For each transfer or cheque received, one click on the unit: the balance and collection rate update.
comptabilite.residentAide1: Each funds call assigns you a share, calculated on your unit's shares (tantièmes).
comptabilite.residentAide2: Your payments recorded by the property manager appear here with their receipt.
comptabilite.residentAide3: The amount left to pay, if any, is updated automatically — nothing for you to do.
comptabilite.subtitle: Everything is calculated automatically from funds calls and recorded payments — no manual entry, no calculations to make.
comptabilite.monReleveSubtitle: Your situation, calculated automatically: what you were called for, what you paid, what remains.
comptabilite.aucunExercice: No funds call issued yet: the accounts will fill in automatically from the first call.
comptabilite.parMoisAide: Amounts called and collected for each period of the financial year.
comptabilite.parLotAide: Sorted by amount due, highest first — the units to chase first.
comptabilite.journalAide: Every recorded payment, most recent first.
comptabilite.aucunPaiement: No payment recorded for this financial year.
comptabilite.aucunBudget: No budget for this financial year.
comptabilite.exportAide: Files compatible with Excel / Google Sheets (“;” separator, amounts in MAD).

lcd.subtitle: Units let as short-term rentals and guest stays — compliance with the rules, building security.
lcd.regimeAide: Set by the co-ownership rules or a general meeting resolution.
lcd.regimeNonDefiniCorps: No declaration is possible until the property manager has recorded the regime decided by the general meeting.
lcd.regimeNonDefiniSyndic: Record the regime (allowed, regulated or prohibited) to open declarations.
lcd.regimeInterditCorps: The co-ownership rules prohibit short-term rental. No declaration can be recorded.
lcd.regimeAutorisee: Short-term rental is allowed without prior approval: declarations are approved automatically.
lcd.regimeEncadree: Short-term rental is regulated: each unit must be declared and approved by the property manager.
lcd.reglementSubtitle: The regime and its settings apply to all units in the residence.

regimeDescriptions.NON_DEFINI: The general meeting has not yet decided: no declaration possible.
regimeDescriptions.AUTORISEE: Owners declare their units and stays; automatic approval.
regimeDescriptions.ENCADREE: Each unit must be approved by the property manager; the settings below apply.
regimeDescriptions.INTERDITE: All short-term rental is prohibited in the residence.

lcd.parametresAide: Leave a field blank if the rules set no limit — the platform never guesses a value.
lcd.declarationPrealable: Prior declaration of each stay required
lcd.delaiDeclarationAide: Hours before arrival. Blank = no notice required.
lcd.nuitsMax: Maximum nights per year per unit
lcd.gestionnaireObligatoire: Manager required if the owner is absent
lcd.contactGardien: Caretaker contact required for each stay
lcd.agResolutionAide: ID of the adopted resolution setting this regime (optional — the resolution must be adopted).
lcd.aucuneDeclarationAide: Owners who let their unit as a short-term rental must declare it here.
lcd.aucuneDeclarationResident: You have not declared any unit for short-term rental.
lcd.declarerLotTitre: Declare a unit for short-term rental
lcd.declarerLotAide: Only one open declaration per unit. Depending on the regime, the property manager will approve it.
lcd.gestionnaireAide: Concierge service or person managing stays on your behalf.
lcd.gestionnaireIdAide: Only if they already have an account in the residence. Otherwise, appoint them after the declaration.
lcd.declareeEnAttente: Declaration recorded — awaiting the property manager's approval.
lcd.decisionAide: The owner and the manager will be notified.
lcd.motifAide: Required for a refusal or suspension — the owner will see it.
lcd.gestionnaireInvite: Invitation created — pass this code on to the manager:
lcd.cloturerAide: The unit will no longer be treated as a short-term rental. Not possible if a stay is planned or in progress.
lcd.aucunSejourAide: Declare each stay before the guests arrive: the caretaker will be informed.
lcd.sejourDeclare: Stay declared. The caretaker has been informed.
lcd.lotSejourAide: Only units with an approved declaration can host a stay.
lcd.aucunLotValide: No unit with an approved declaration: declare your unit first.
lcd.pieceIdentiteAide: Only the last 4 characters are kept — the full number is never stored (CNDP).
lcd.annulerAide: The caretaker will be informed. A cancelled stay cannot be reinstated.
lcd.piecesJointesAide: Booking confirmation, arrival photo, inventory report: images or PDF, 10 at most. Never an identity document — identity documents are not kept.
lcd.aucuneDeclarationLot: This unit is not declared for short-term rental.
lcd.chargementImpossible: Short-term rental data could not be loaded.

depenses.subtitle: Money going out: invoices, works, salaries, energy — every dirham approved, paid and justified.
depenses.aucuneAide: Create an expense as soon as the first invoice arrives: it will go through approval and then payment.
depenses.posteAide: The expense category follows that of the budget item. Leave blank for an off-budget expense.
depenses.montantsAide: Excl. VAT + VAT must equal incl. VAT. The amount incl. VAT alone is enough if the invoice does not itemise VAT.
depenses.sourceAide: A withdrawal from the reserve fund requires an adopted GM resolution.
depenses.resolutionAgAide: Works voted at a meeting — required for the reserve fund.
depenses.seuilNonConfigureCorps: Every submitted expense requires explicit approval by the property manager. In Settings, set the amount above which the owners' council decides.
depenses.creeeAide: It is a draft: complete it, attach the invoice, then submit it for approval.
depenses.soumettreCorps: Below the configured threshold, the expense is approved immediately; above it, the owners' council is notified and decides.
depenses.approuverCorps: Approval authorises the property manager to pay “{libelle}” ({montant}). It is recorded in the log.
depenses.rejeterMotifAide: The reason is sent to the property manager and kept in the log.
depenses.payerCorps: No bank connection: enter the method and reference exactly as on the statement, and attach proof (transfer receipt, photo of the cheque).
depenses.referenceAide: Transfer or cheque no. — key for bank reconciliation.
depenses.justificatifAide: Transfer receipt, photo of the cheque or deposit slip (image or PDF, 15 MB max).
depenses.payeeReserve: The entry has been posted to the reserve fund ledger.
depenses.annulerCorps: A cancelled expense remains visible in the log. A paid expense cannot be cancelled: create an adjustment expense.
depenses.contesterFactureConsequence: The dispute is recorded in the expense log. While disputed, the invoice is not settled by the expense payment and no longer triggers due-date reminders. You can set it back to “verified” later.
depenses.journalAide: Immutable log: each step is timestamped and signed.
depenses.exporterCsvAide: UTF-8, “;” separator (Excel). Every export is logged.
depenses.depuisIncident: Create an expense from this incident
depenses.depuisIncidentAide: Pre-filled draft: assigned supplier, category and incident description.
depenses.aucuneDepenseLiee: No expense linked to this incident.
depenses.postesSubtitle: The budget total is the sum of its lines. Edit the lines, not the total.
depenses.posteModifieApresActivation: Active budget: every line change is tracked as a revision.
depenses.prevuVsRealiseAide: Light bar: planned. Dark bar: paid. Stripes: overrun.
depenses.aucunBudgetActif: No active budget for this financial year: expenses are tracked outside the budget.
depenses.ribAfficherAide: Viewing restricted to the property manager and logged.
depenses.ribAide: 24 digits. Stored encrypted in the database, never shown in clear without an explicit action.
depenses.evaluerCorps: Your rating (1 to 5) feeds the contractor's average, visible to the property manager and the council. It cannot be changed.
depenses.evalue: Thank you, your rating has been saved.

cabinet.aucuneCoproprieteAide: Propose a mandate on an existing co-ownership (its property manager confirms) or create a directly managed residence.
cabinet.aucuneAlerte: No alerts — the whole portfolio is on track.

cabinet.agendaAide: GMs, contract due dates, tasks, payroll and mandate end dates for all your co-ownerships, in order.

cabinet.membreAjoute: Member added — their co-ownership access has been applied.
cabinet.retirerCorps: Their property manager / accountant roles granted by the firm are revoked immediately on all co-ownerships.

cabinet.honorairesAide: Creates a monthly SYNDIC_PROFESSIONNEL contract whose instalments feed HONORAIRES_SYNDIC expenses.
cabinet.mandatPropose: Mandate proposed — the current property manager must confirm.
cabinet.terminerCorps: The firm loses the co-ownership: its members' access is revoked immediately; the co-ownership has no property manager until a new appointment.
cabinet.prestatairesAide: Templates shared by the firm: copy them into a co-ownership (each residence keeps its own profile).
cabinet.seuilRecouvrementAide: A co-ownership below this rate is flagged.
cabinet.delaiJustificatifsAide: A supporting document pending longer is flagged.
cabinet.mandatCoproAide: Professional firm mandated for this co-ownership.
cabinet.aucunMandatCopro: No property management firm is mandated for this co-ownership.
cabinet.confirmerCorps: You are handing over your property manager role to the manager appointed by the firm. Your property manager access ends immediately; the action is recorded.
cabinet.confirme: Handover confirmed — the firm now manages the co-ownership.

importation.subtitle: Your residence in one hour: import the previous property manager's spreadsheet (units, owners, balances), fix the columns, check the preview, run it — nothing is imported twice.
importation.fichierAide: First row = headers. Empty rows, merged cells and phone numbers with spaces are accepted. 5,000 rows maximum.
importation.modelesAide: One file per type, with a sample row — fill it in or map your own columns in the next step.
importation.mappingAide: Columns were recognised by their headers (French, Arabic, English). Fix anything missing: all required fields must be mapped.
importation.dateReferenceAide: Used when the file has no date (“as at”).
importation.inviterAide: One pre-filled invitation per person (same phone = same person, all their units). Nothing is sent until you click “Send invitations”.
importation.aucuneErreur: No errors in the rows shown.
importation.nbErreursAide: Rows with errors are skipped when running and listed in the report; fix them, then rerun the same file.
importation.executerAide: The import runs in the background in batches of 50 rows; you can follow progress here.
importation.annulerCorps: The run stops between two batches; rows already applied remain.
importation.aucunImportAide: Start with units and owners, then opening balances — the first funds call will be correct.
importation.invitationsMasseAide: Invitations created by an import are never sent automatically. Choose the channel: SMS / email (if a provider is configured) or a csv file with the links (WhatsApp, manual sending).
importation.telecharge: File generated — send the links yourself.
importation.onboardingAide: What remains to be done so the first funds call is correct and residents are on board.
importation.onboardingComplet: Residence ready — everything is in place.
importation.creerDemoAide: A disposable residence based on Al Amal for a prospect: units, budget, funds call, incidents, parking. Purged after 30 days. The SYNDIC invitation code is then displayed.

typesImportAide.LOTS_PROPRIETAIRES: Unit no., shares, floor, building, owner, phone, ownership share.

typesImportAide.PRESTATAIRES: Name, specialty, phone, email, ICE, RC.
typesImportAide.CONTRATS: Label, type, contractor, dates, frequency, amount.
typesImportAide.VEHICULES_BADGES: Unit no., plate, make, badge, deposit.
typesImportAide.PERSONNEL: Name, phone, position, hire date, salary, CNSS — pre-filled GARDIEN invitation.

parkings.subtitleGardien: Map, today's visitor spaces, plate search and badges.
parkings.redevanceAide: Internal rental voted at the GM: called on the 1st of each month (“Parking fee” funds call).
parkings.resolutionAgAide: ID of the ADOPTEE resolution deciding the assignment (optional).
parkings.supprimerCorps: A space with no history is deleted; with history, set it out of service.
parkings.attribue: Assignment saved — the unit's residents have been notified.
parkings.libererCorps: The current assignment ends (last day of occupancy); the space becomes available again and the unit's residents are notified.
parkings.aucunEmplacementAide: Create the residence's shared, visitor, disabled, motorbike and bike spaces and shared storage.
parkings.aucunEmplacementResident: No space is assigned to you.
parkings.retirerVehiculeCorps: The vehicle is deactivated (no longer recognised at the entrance); its history is kept.
parkings.aucunVehiculeAide: Residents register their vehicles; the caretaker recognises plates at the entrance.
parkings.rechercherAide: Restricted to the caretaker and the property manager — every search is logged.
parkings.aucunResultat: Unknown plate: outside vehicle (towing procedure as per the bylaws).
parkings.badgeRemis: Badge issued — the unit has been notified.
parkings.cautionAide: Amount in MAD; optional link to the payment that collected it (same unit).
parkings.declarerPerduCorps: The badge is set to LOST: the property manager is notified and a “deactivate badge” task is created.
parkings.restituerCorps: The badge is returned; indicate whether the deposit was refunded (recorded in the audit log).
parkings.desactiverCorps: The badge will no longer work (after loss or departure).
parkings.aucunBadgeAide: Pedestrian badges, parking remotes, storage keys, lift cards issued to units.
parkings.visiteursJourAide: Visits recorded by the caretaker and short-term stays allocated; the caretaker is alerted when the time limit is exceeded.
parkings.attribuerPlaceAide: Only an in-service visitor space; the plate and time limit help with checks.

taches.aucuneAide: Create the first task or let the modules create them: an adopted resolution, a contract renewal or a completed report generate one automatically.
taches.aucuneMienne: No tasks are assigned to you.
taches.assigneeAide: Property manager, council member or staff member.
taches.recurrenceAide: When closed, the next task is created automatically.
taches.piecesJointesAide: Photos or PDF (15 MB max each).
taches.annulerCorps: The task is kept in the history with the status “Cancelled”.
taches.occurrenceDe: Next occurrence of the recurring task

communication.subtitle: Residence announcements, ongoing polls and useful numbers — instead of the WhatsApp group.
communication.nouvelleAide: Write it, choose the audience, publish now or on a chosen date. Residents are notified depending on the category.
communication.aucuneAide: Publish the first announcement: outage, works, social event… every resident will see it here and be notified.
communication.contenuAide: Light formatting: **bold**, *italic*, lists (- ), links https://… — HTML is neutralised.
communication.audienceAide: Who will see the announcement and be notified; the “One building” audience targets residents of that building's units.
communication.batimentAide: Must match the building entered on the units (e.g. A, B).
communication.epingler: Pin to the top of the board
communication.expirationAide: Optional: the announcement disappears from the board after this date.
communication.commentairesDesactives: Comments are disabled on this announcement.
communication.piecesJointesAide: Images or PDF (15 MB max each), visible to the audience.
communication.publierCorps: The announcement becomes visible to its audience and residents are notified (URGENT: notification + SMS). The publication date is timestamped.
communication.archiverCorps: The announcement leaves the notice board; history and reads are kept.
communication.desarchivee: Archiving undone: the announcement is back on the board.
communication.lecteursAide: Visible only to the property manager and the council — never to residents.
communication.aucuneLecture: No one has opened this announcement yet.
communication.masque: Comment hidden by the property manager
communication.masqueAide: The comment remains visible to its author and the property manager.
communication.urgenceSyndic: URGENT announcements are reserved for the property manager.
communication.nouveauSondageAide: One question, 2 to 10 options, an end date. Advisory only: it is never a general meeting vote.
communication.mention: Advisory poll: it has no value as a general meeting vote (Doc A §6).
communication.question: Question
communication.anonymeAide: Results are always aggregated; no one sees who answered what.
communication.ponderationAide: Also shows results weighted by the respondents' unit shares — with no legal value.
communication.ouvrirCorps: Residents in the audience are notified and can answer until the end date.
communication.cloreCorps: No more answers will be accepted; results are sent to the audience.
communication.reponseEnvoyee: Thank you, your answer has been saved.
communication.resultatsApres: Results are shown after you answer or when the poll closes.
communication.contactsAide: Emergency numbers and the residence's contractors — tap to call.
communication.preferencesAide: How to receive announcements and the weekly summary.
communication.digestHebdoAide: Unread announcements and open polls, in a single message.
communication.pushAide: Banners, alerts and lock screen depending on importance. Emergencies (visitor at the door, serious incident, long-overdue arrears) are always delivered, even in Do Not Disturb mode.
communication.pushNormalAide: Funds calls, incidents, bookings, tasks: banner with sound.
communication.pushInfoAide: Documents, minutes, summaries, polls: discreet banner, no sound.
communication.pushSonAide: When off, standard notifications remain visible but silent.
communication.resumeMatinAide: At 8 am, a discreet notification: charges to pay, upcoming meeting, incidents, unread announcements. Nothing is sent if there is nothing to report.
communication.heuresCalmesAide: During this period, nothing rings or wakes the screen — except emergencies. Casablanca time.

contrats.attestationAide: PDF or photo of the current certificate (visible to the owners' council).
contrats.documentSigneAide: PDF or photo of the signed contract (property manager only).
contrats.referenceAide: Contract or policy no. as shown on the document.
contrats.dateFinAide: Leave blank for an open-ended term.
contrats.taciteAide: On the end date, the contract is extended for the same period and the schedule is regenerated.
contrats.preavisAide: A “Renewal” due date is set this many days before the end.
contrats.montantPeriodeAide: Incl. VAT — applied to each payment due date.
contrats.posteAide: Expenses generated from due dates are charged to it.
contrats.resolutionAgAide: Required to activate a contract above the co-ownership's threshold.
contrats.seuilNonConfigure: GM commitment threshold not configured: no check on activation.
contrats.activerCorps: The contract becomes active and its schedule for the next 12 months is generated. D-30 / D-7 reminders start.
contrats.suspendreCorps: Reminders and due dates are paused until reactivation.
contrats.resilierCorps: Due dates after the termination date are cancelled. This action is final.
contrats.echeancierAide: Generated automatically from the frequency; add technical visits and regulatory inspections.
contrats.genererDepenseTitre: Create the expense for this due date
contrats.genererDepenseCorps: A draft expense is created, linked to the contract, budget line and contractor. You then submit it like any other expense.
contrats.creeAide: Enter the contract as signed; activate it to generate the schedule.

rapports.douzeMoisAide: Current account receipts and disbursements month by month, with the estimated balance.
rapports.recouvrementAide: Collected vs called for the financial year.
rapports.impayesAide: Unpaid overdue call lines, by age.
rapports.aucunBudget: No active budget for this financial year.
rapports.grandLivreSubtitle: The chronological journal for the financial year: every validated payment, every paid expense, every reserve fund entry, with running balances.
rapports.aucuneLigne: No entries for this financial year.
rapports.gestionSubtitle: The report the property manager presents to the general meeting: frozen figures, PDF in French and Arabic, approval by resolution.

rapports.pdfEchec: The PDF could not be produced: the report remains a draft, regenerate it.
rapports.aucunRapportAide: Generate the report for the past financial year to submit it to the general meeting.

rapports.soumettreTitre: Submit the report to the general meeting

rapports.aucuneAgEligible: No GM planned or convened: create one first.
rapports.typeMajoriteAide: According to the co-ownership bylaws; not legally confirmed (brief §9).
rapports.soumisAide: The resolution has been added. The vote result will update the report automatically.
rapports.impayesSubtitle: All overdue amounts, from the oldest to the most recent. Filter by bracket to prepare reminders.
rapports.aucunImpayeAide: All past due dates are settled.
rapports.exportsSubtitle: CSV and Excel extracts of management data. Every export is logged (who, what, when) — CNDP requirement.
rapports.exportLotsAide: All units with shares, occupants and balance due.
rapports.exportProprietairesAide: Personal data (contact, ownership share) — property manager only.
rapports.exportImpayesAide: Overdue lines with age and escalation level.
rapports.exportPaiementsAide: Payment journal for the financial year.
rapports.exportDepensesAide: All expenses for the financial year with their status.
rapports.exportIncidentsAide: All tickets with urgency, status and contractor.

rapports.rapportsSoumisAide: Reports submitted to the general meeting — view them in documents.
rapports.aucuneDepense: No paid expenses for this financial year.

justificatifs.virementAide: Make the transfer to one of the co-ownership's accounts, then declare it below with the receipt.
justificatifs.aucunCompte: The property manager has not yet entered a bank account.
justificatifs.aucunCompteAide: Enter at least one account so residents can pay by transfer.
justificatifs.especesAide: Hand the cash to the caretaker or property manager: the payment is recorded and you will receive the receipt after confirmation.
justificatifs.declarerAide: State what you paid, how, and attach the proof. The property manager checks the statement, then validates.
justificatifs.surSolde: Against my balance (applied to the oldest due dates)
justificatifs.referenceAide: Transfer or cheque no. as shown on your receipt.
justificatifs.preuveAide: Transfer receipt, photo of the cheque or deposit slip (image or PDF, 15 MB max).
justificatifs.declareAide: The property manager has been notified. You will be notified once it is validated — your receipt will then be available.
justificatifs.aucunAide: Payments declared by residents will appear here.
justificatifs.aucunePreuve: No proof attached (cash entered by the property manager or caretaker).
justificatifs.aucuneLigneOuverte: No open due dates: the unit is up to date.
justificatifs.imputationCible: To the due date chosen by the declarant.
justificatifs.imputationFifo: Against balance: oldest due dates first.

justificatifs.dateValeurAide: Defaults to the date declared by the resident.
justificatifs.rejeterMotifAide: The resident is notified of the reason and can declare again.
justificatifs.especesSubtitle: Record each cash payment: the property manager confirms, the resident receives their receipt.
justificatifs.especesAideGardien: The payment is sent to the property manager for confirmation. You do not need to enter the due dates.

peutEtreEnregistre.message: This action may already have been saved — refresh the page to check.

envoyes.aide: They will be reused as they are if you try again.

confirmer.justificatifAnnulerConsequence: The property manager will not process it. The declaration stays on file with the status “Cancelled” and cannot be restored: for this payment, you will need to submit a new one.
confirmer.justificatifRejeterConsequence: The co-owner is notified with your reason. The rejection is timestamped and kept on file: it cannot be undone.
confirmer.procurationRevoquerConsequence: The proxy holder will no longer be able to vote for this unit. The revocation is timestamped and kept in the meeting file; to restore it, a new proxy must be given.
confirmer.congeAnnulerConsequence: The request is set to “Cancelled” and stays in the HR history. For these dates, a new request will be needed.
confirmer.contactSupprimerConsequence: Residents will no longer see it on the notice board. You can enter it again later.
confirmer.logoRetirerConsequence: Documents generated from now on (funds calls, receipts, minutes) will no longer show a logo. You can upload another one at any time.
confirmer.photoRetirerConsequence: The default image replaces it immediately for all residents. You can upload another one.
confirmer.pieceRetirerConsequence: The file is deleted from the record: you will need to upload it again if the caretaker needs it.
confirmer.annonceSupprimerConsequence: The draft is permanently deleted. An announcement already published is archived, not deleted.
confirmer.sondageSupprimerConsequence: The draft is permanently deleted. An open poll is closed, not deleted.
confirmer.commentaireMasquerConsequence: It disappears for residents. A record of the moderation is kept.
confirmer.echeanceAnnulerConsequence: It will no longer trigger reminders and cannot generate an expense. It remains visible in the schedule with the status “Cancelled”.
confirmer.convoquerConsequence: Notices of meeting are sent by email to residence members, according to the co-ownership's settings. This action cannot be undone: sending is timestamped and starts the legal notice period.
confirmer.ouvrirConsequence: The quorum is recorded at this moment and voting opens. The opening is timestamped in the minutes and cannot be undone.
confirmer.agAnnulerConsequence: Co-owners will be informed and this reason will be kept on file. A cancelled meeting cannot be restored: a new one must be created.
confirmer.finaliserConsequence: Votes are frozen and the result is calculated now. It will be entered in the minutes and can no longer be changed.
confirmer.depenseRejeterConsequence: The rejection is timestamped in the expense log with your reason; it cannot be undone.
